leader.name: Bola Ahmed Tinubu
leader.bio: An accountant, former senator and former governor of Lagos State, Tinubu became Nigeria’s president after winning the 2023 election.

record.text: Removed the petrol subsidy, ended monetary financing of the fiscal deficit and changed the foreign-exchange framework; the IMF says the package improved macroeconomic stability and resilience.
The reforms strengthened foreign reserves and renewed portfolio inflows, while the government argued they prevented a deeper fiscal crisis.

scrutiny.text: Subsidy removal and naira depreciation sharply raised living costs; inflation and reduced purchasing power remain central public concerns.
Persistent killings, kidnappings and regional insecurity continue to draw criticism of the federal government’s security record.
